//: Regional price table for Ad Interceptor Pro, provider-neutral.
//why: Extracted from scripts/paddle-pricing.mjs on 2026-09-12 when the integration moved to Dodo Payments. The Paddle API plumbing around it was deleted (it lives in git history); this TABLE is product knowledge and outlives any vendor.
//howToApply: Dodo calls this 'Localized Pricing' — a fixed price per currency/country, as opposed to 'Adaptive Currency' which just converts the USD base at live FX. Applying 25 overrides by hand is exactly the repetitive work that produces a 100x error nobody notices until a customer complains, so script it against Dodo's API and VERIFY by asking what a buyer would actually be charged rather than trusting the arithmetic.
//decimalTrap: Amounts here are in MAJOR units (14.99 = fourteen ninety-nine). Most payment APIs take the LOWEST denomination, where 14.99 becomes 1499. JPY and KRW are ZERO-decimal, so 2200 stays 2200. Getting this wrong does not error — it silently prices 100x off in either direction. `decimals` is explicit on every row so a conversion can never guess.
//tiers: par = full price for a high-income market. ppp = reduced against local price levels. These are round numbers chosen to read as deliberate local prices, based on approximate relative price levels, NOT looked-up official PPP tables.

prices.//: Priced to unlock UPI. Under Paddle this needed an INR price for customers in India and a recurring total under 15,000 INR. Dodo is India-based and supports UPI directly, so CONFIRM its own constraints rather than carrying Paddle's forward.
